levels.name: Campus Recruitment
levels.subtitle: Intern & Summer Analyst Level
levels.description: Master core financial accounting, statement analysis, ratios, and time value of money basics for entry-level finance roles.

rooms.name: Financial Statements Basics
rooms.description: Understand the Balance Sheet, P&L, and Cash Flow Statement relationships.

rooms.name: Financial Ratios & Metrics
rooms.description: Master liquidity, profitability, turnover, and leverage ratios across Indian sectors.

rooms.name: Time Value of Money
rooms.description: Evaluate Present Value, Future Value, Net Present Value (NPV), and Internal Rate of Return (IRR).

levels.name: First Round Interview
levels.subtitle: Analyst Level
levels.description: Navigate working capital cycles, introductory corporate valuation multiples, and the Cost of Capital (WACC).

rooms.name: Working Capital Management
rooms.description: Cash conversion cycle, inventory management, receivables financing, and liquidity buffer.

rooms.name: Valuation Fundamentals
rooms.description: Trading comparables, transaction comps, EV/EBITDA, P/E ratios, and enterprise value bridge.

rooms.name: Cost of Capital
rooms.description: Calculate Cost of Equity using CAPM, Cost of Debt post-tax, and Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC).

levels.name: Technical Round
levels.subtitle: Associate Level
levels.description: Tackle 3-statement integrated modeling, Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) mechanics, and capital budgeting.

rooms.name: Financial Modeling
rooms.description: 3-statement linking mechanics, circular interest schedules, and working capital schedules.

rooms.name: Investment Analysis
rooms.description: Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Unlevered Free Cash Flows, Terminal Value (Gordon Growth vs Exit Multiple).

rooms.name: Corporate Finance Decisions
rooms.description: Dividend policy vs share buybacks in India, capital rationing, and leasing vs buying.

levels.name: Case Study Round
levels.subtitle: Senior Associate Level
levels.description: Analyze M&A accretion/dilution, synergy valuation, FX & interest rate hedging, and growth financing.

rooms.name: M&A Fundamentals
rooms.description: Accretion/dilution analysis, exchange ratios, purchase price allocation, and synergy realization.

rooms.name: Risk Management
rooms.description: Foreign currency exposure, forward contracts vs options, interest rate swaps, and credit risk.

rooms.name: Strategic Finance
rooms.description: Unit economics for tech startups, burn rate, customer acquisition cost (CAC) vs LTV, and IPO pricing.

levels.name: Partner Interview
levels.subtitle: VP / Managing Director Level
levels.description: Solve high-stakes board-level dilemmas: optimal capital structure, distressed turnarounds, and cross-disciplinary master questions.

rooms.name: Advanced Valuation
rooms.description: SOTP valuation, holding company discounts in Indian conglomerates, and real options valuation.

rooms.name: Capital Structure Optimization
rooms.description: Modigliani-Miller theorem with taxes, financial distress costs, debt covenants, and rating agency metrics.

rooms.name: Final Partner Challenge
rooms.description: Comprehensive simulation covering multi-topic curveball questions asked by IB Partners and PE Principals.
